subject.title: [Bug]: active-memory embedded run cannot resolve Lossless Claw lcm_* tools despite runtime plugin inspect showing them registered

question: Should maintainers require live current-main Lossless Claw proof before authorizing a fix for Active Memory embedded `lcm_*` tool resolution?
rationale: Current source and docs make the report credible, but the resolver path crosses Active Memory, embedded agent setup, plugin manifests, and an external plugin; a source-only repair could target the wrong layer.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Run a current-main Gateway with Lossless Claw installed and capture plugin inspect plus Active Memory embedded-run tool-resolution logs before choosing the fix layer.

options.title: Start source-level repair now
options.body: Allow a focused PR to add an integration-style fixture for manifest-declared external tools and repair the resolver path if it fails under test.

options.title: Change the contract
options.body: If external plugin tools are not intended for embedded Active Memory, update config validation and docs to reject the Lossless Claw `toolsAllow` example.

recommendation.title: Require live repro first
recommendation.body: Run a current-main Gateway with Lossless Claw installed and capture plugin inspect plus Active Memory embedded-run tool-resolution logs before choosing the fix layer.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Active Memory custom recall-tool contract and docs that this issue exercises.
